request.spec: Let me see just the open tasks on a project. Or just the finished ones.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me see just the open tasks on a project. Or just the finished ones.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes. The change is complete as a full-stack addition:

- **Server** (`ListTasksLogic.java`): the `GET /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks` endpoint now reads an optional `?status=` query param — `OPEN` returns not-done tasks, `DONE` returns finished ones, anything else returns all — following the same `@HttpQueryParameter` pattern as the existing invoice-sort endpoint.
- **Data access** (`TaskRepository.java`): added `findByProjectIdAndDoneOrderByIdAsc` for the filtered query.
- **Front-end** (`ProjectTasks.tsx`): added a `data-testid="task-filter"` `<select>` (All / Open / Done) that reloads the list with the chosen status.

No DB migration was needed — the `done` column already exists — so I kept the change minimal and additive rather than inventing an unnecessary schema change. Existing `data-testid`s (`task-row-*`, `task-title`, etc.) were left untouched.
